A '''third battle''' was fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] in the [[Semag system/Legends|Semag system]].

==Prelude==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was tasked to destroy the traitorous Grand Admiral [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. To that end Thrawn used Zaarin's desire to get a technological advantage as his weakness. He origanlly had a [[Battle of Serenity|trap]] set at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenity (planet)|Serenity]]. However Zaarin had learnt it was a trap and sent a small force in response. Thrawn decided set another trap by sending a convoy of genuine [[Missile Boat]]s to lure him out. However, Thrawn underestimated the amount of [[Spy/Legends|Spies]] in Zaarin's employ and his [[Task Force Whirlwind]] was [[Ambush in the Semag system|held up]] in an attack. The attack, although driven off, damaged the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] [[Whirlwind (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|Whirlwind]], leaving only [[TIE pilot]] ace [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to defend the convoy.

==The battle==
Stele arrived to find [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] preparing to attack the convoy and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] fighting the [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort Shuttles]]. Stele engaged and assited the shuttles in destroying the fighters and as the last few remained Zaarin's [[Flagship/Legends|Flagship]] the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Glory]]'' arrived with [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack-class lifht Cruiser]] ''[[Yaai]]'' and [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Thinin]]''. [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault Transports]], TIE Defenders and [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] launched from the ''Glory'' to attack the convoy so that they could disable and capture it. But Stele attempted to fight them of whenever he could, while inspecting the enemy starships as per orders from the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]]. Before any transport could disable and capture the convoy, Thrawn arrived in his Star Destroyer ''[[Grey Wolf]]'', along with another Star Destroyer [[Resolution (Imperial-class)|''Resolution'']] and two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]]. [[Indomitable (Strike-class)|''Indomitable'']] and [[Triumph (Strike-class)|''Triumph'']] giving [[Zaarin's fleet]] heavy casualties. Because the ''Whirlwind'' was not present, Zaarin was able to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] as the remaining starfighters fought and gave their lives.

==Aftermath==
The battle was undeniably a loss to Zaarin. Losing so many fighters and two medium starships to Thrawn was giving loyalist forces a boost in morale.

With the convoy saved it jumped into hyperspace to a training facility few elite pilots at an undisclosed location. Unfortunately, they didn't arrive and mysteriously disappeared. Worse was that Zaarin had learn't that the [[Vorknkx Project]] had just made progress and Zaarin made his [[Attack on Vorknkx Project Base|next move]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' in Battle 11, Mission 5. This article assumes completion of "Primary", "Secondary" and "Bonus" Goals completed.
